name: labs/kagisokgwahla__capstone-molecule-environment
title: molecule-v0 molecular editing environment
intro: molecule-v0 molecular editing environment, adapted from kagisokgwahla/capstone-molecule-environment. It reads `observation`, `tick` and `episode`; runs `step` and `reset_world`. `step`: advance the simulated world by a bounded number of fixed timesteps, optionally applying an action for each step, and return the resulting observation and terminal flags. A simulator: the market serves it with a stand-in that needs no simulator install.
